TWO PERSONS KIDNAPPED FROM PARAMOUNT BALLROOM
BY ARMED MEN WHO USED HANDCUFFS.

At 11.15p.m. 16/8/40, Mr. Tsoong Tuh Ching
(      ), manager of the Paramount Ballroom, Yu
Yuen Road, came to the station and reported that
four men, all armed with pistols, and carrying hand-
cuffs, had come into the Ballroom, gone up to a
table near the entrance, and attempted to take into
custody the four persons who were sitting there.
Mr. Tsoong said he had run out as soon as he
saw what was taking place, and thought the party
might still be there.
A party under Insp. Curtis at once attended,
but on arrival, the armed men had already gone, tak-
ing with them only two of the persons.
It appears that the armed men left in a hurry,
fearing intervention by the Police, for they had
handcuffed the two persons they left behind.
The two persons, Mr. Bien Tsung (卞 虎 ),
chemist, employed by the Tien Chee (天 池 ) Paint
Factory, San Ka Au (曾 家 坳 ) village, off Yu Yuen
Road, and living at 66B/66 Yu Yuen Road, and Mr.
Wang Chen Tseng (王 健 昌 ), export merchant, 239/13
Avenue Road, were asked to come to this station when
they gave the following story:-
pages.zh:
两名人员在百乐门舞厅被持械并使用手铐的男子绑架。

1940年8月16日晚上11点15分，愚园路百乐门舞厅经理宗笃清先生（Tsoong Tuh Ching，音译）来到警署报案称，四名男子均持有手枪并携带手铐进入舞厅，走到靠近入口的一张桌子旁，试图拘捕坐在那里的四人。宗先生说，他看到发生的事情后立即跑了出去，心想那伙人可能还在那里。
柯蒂斯巡官（Insp. Curtis）率领的一队人马立即前往，但到达时，持械男子已经离开，只带走了其中的两人。
看来持械男子因害怕警方干预而匆忙离开，因为他们给留下的两人戴上了手铐。
这两人分别是卞虎先生（Bien Tsung），化学师，受雇于愚园路曾家坳村的天池油漆厂，居住在愚园路66B/66号；以及王健昌先生（Wang Chen Tseng），出口商人，爱文义路239/13号。他们来到本警署后讲述了以下经过：

pages.en:

engineer in the Shanghai Telephone Co.,
formerly Chief Engineer, Park Hotel.
room 609, Pacific Hotel, Nanking Road.

Mr. Zau Vung Ping (趙雲平), Tel.No.61682,

friends of Mr. Zau, took dinner at the Zoh Yee Chuen
(聚義春) Restaurant, Kwangse Road.

They went at the invitation of Mr. C.C. Wu who
called them by telephone.

At dinner, no particular subject was discussed,
and Mr. Zau suggested they go on to the Paramount.

Mr. Zau, accompanied by Mr. C.C. Wu and the two
dancing girls, drove off in Mr. Zau's car, license
number unknown, with a chauffeur at the wheel.

Dr. Zung went home, saying he was tired, and the
two females had asked to be escorted home.

Mr. Zau and Mr. Wu arrived first at the Paramount
Ballroom, Mr. Hian and Mr. Vung arriving later at 11
o'clock, as they had travelled by motor bus.

They took a table near the entrance, ordered
drinks, and had been sitting down for about five

张忠志医生（Dr. Zung Tseong Chi，音译），

以及两名女性，据信是舞女，也是赵先生的朋友，在广西路聚義春餐厅共进晚餐。

她们是应吴先生通过电话邀请前去的。

晚餐期间未讨论特定话题，赵先生建议去百乐门。

赵先生在司机驾驶下，乘坐其汽车（车牌号不详），与吴先生及两名舞女一同驱车离开。

张医生称因疲倦回家，两名女性则要求护送回家。

赵先生和吴先生先到达百乐门舞厅，咸先生（Mr. Hian，音译）和荣先生（Mr. Vung，音译）因乘坐公共汽车，于11点左右随后到达。

他们在靠近入口处占了一张桌子，点了饮料，坐下约五分钟

TWO PERSONS KIDNAPPED FROM PARAMOUNT BALLROOM
BY ARMED MEN WHO USED HANDCUFFS.

Motor car, licence No. 7029, the property of
Mr. V. P. Zau, has been located. It was seen outside
the Paramount at 8a.m. 19/8/40. The chauffeur Tsang
Lee Sung (曾李生), permit No. 19031 states that he
drove his master, accompanied by another man and a
woman (this would be Mr. C.C. Wu and one of the
dancing girls) to the Paramount Ballroom. Later, he
took the car west along Yu Yuen Road and took dinner.
He then drove the car back to the Paramount and await-
ed the arrival of his master.

The chauffeur denies that he saw his master leave
the Ballroom, and when brought to the station was under
the impression his master was still inside.

Mr. V.P. Zau, the chauffeur states, is a Customs
broker, with offices at 300 French Bund.

The chauffeur and the car have been detained at
this station pending further instructions.

John Capick
Sen. Det. S.I.O.

NB Greenfield
D. S. S.I.

B.D.O. "B" Div.

两名人员在百乐门舞厅被持械并使用手铐的男子绑架。

已找到车牌号为7029的汽车，该车为V. P. Zau先生所有。1940年8月19日上午8点有人在百乐门外看到该车。司机曾李生（Tsang Lee Sung），执照号19031，陈述称他驾车送主人及另一名男子和一名女子（这应是吴先生和其中一名舞女）前往百乐门舞厅。随后，他驾车沿愚园路向西行驶去用餐。之后他将车开回百乐门，等待主人到来。

司机否认看到主人离开舞厅，被带到警署时，他以为主人仍在里面。

司机称，V.P. Zau先生是一名报关行经纪人，办公室位于法外滩300号。

司机和车辆已被扣留于本警署，等候进一步指示。

August 19, 1940.
Morning Translation

National Herald, Chinese-American Daily News, Shun Pao, Sin Wan
Pao :-

Two Men Kidnapped From Paramount Ballroom

At 12.15 a.m. to-day, while four men were
sitting at a table in Paramount Ballroom on Yu Yuen Road,
four armed male Chinese entered and handcuffed two of the
men, stating that they had been ordered to effect their arrest.
The two men were then taken to a waiting motor car which drove
away immediately. The remaining two guests then made a
report to Bubbling Well Police Station.
According to information secured by our
reporter, the two abducted men are Tsai Wen-ping (蔡文彬),
residing at House 42, Passage 613, Avenue Joffre, who was
formerly a politician, and the other is Woo (吴), an
engineer, residing at Room No.609, Golden Gate Hotel (金门饭店),
Bubbling Well Road. The names of the other two guests are
Wong Chien-chong (王健昌) and Pi Cheng (毕正), friends
of the abducted men.
The Police are conducting an investigation
into the affair.

FILE

1940年8月19日。
晨间翻译

《国民日报》、《中美日报》、《申报》、《新闻报》：

两名男子在百乐门舞厅被绑架

今日凌晨12点15分，当四名男子坐在愚园路百乐门舞厅的一张桌旁时，四名持械的中国男子进入，给其中两人戴上手铐，声称奉命执行逮捕。随后这两人被带上一辆等候的汽车，随即驶离。其余两名客人随后向静安寺警署报案。
据本报记者获得的消息，两名被绑架者分别是蔡文彬（Tsai Wen-ping），居住于霞飞路613弄42号，前政客；另一人是吴氏（Woo），工程师，居住于静安寺路金门饭店609室。另外两名客人的名字是王健昌（Wong Chien-chong）和毕正（Pi Cheng），系被绑架者的朋友。
警方正在对此事进行调查。

档案
